goals: Preserve a player's component-exact organization intent after a physical stack leaves an eligible vanilla storage slot.
Apply the same reservation admission rule to manual placement, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, and vanilla hopper insertion without changing extraction, destination order, or routing policy.

Render empty reservations as the original item sprite with its RGB and hue preserved at approximately 35% opacity, with a vanilla-positioned literal zero, while preserving the occupied marker and empty-reservation hover tooltip.

Overlay the same reservation visuals on the exact 27 physical slots of supported Easy Shulker Boxes and Item Interactions vanilla-shulker tooltips without changing contents, calculations, selection, interaction, or server behavior.

Keep reservation persistence, synchronization, user actions, and insertion server-authoritative while exposing defensive classification and reservation queries without becoming an item-routing engine.
scope: Maintain exact Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric Canary 3 from implementation and artifact checkpoint d69469ba90b0d85a257db57ce65588e63f4cc248, physically verified in Test Slot A at manager revision 74, while preserving accepted Canary 1 as rollback and exact failed Canary 2 as immutable provenance.

Store sparse format-1 reservations as immutable count-one ItemStackTemplate values in a persistent, network-synchronized project component; item identity remains exactly component-aware while count is excluded.
Support exact vanilla chest, trapped-chest, barrel, undyed shulker, and all 16 dyed shulker owners, with double-chest logical slots resolved to the owning physical half and local slot 0 through 26.

Preserve Canary 2 reservation identity, persistence, synchronization, server authority, ownership and physical-slot mapping, carried-shulker round trips, component-exact templates, manual insertion, vanilla QUICK_MOVE, hopper admission, literal-zero placement, compact occupied marker, hover tooltip, optional overlay behavior, and all reservation-free rendering.

Render an empty reservation through a ghost-only custom premultiplied pipeline whose neutral straight packed input is 0x59FFFFFF; its shader attenuates the cached premultiplied sprite RGB and alpha exactly once by 0x59/255, preserving original hue and transparency without tint, matte, backing, or fill.
Treat #43362A only as the Matcha GUI item-slot background that must show through naturally; never use it as an item tint or precomposition color.

Audit both Minecraft 26.2 item paths fail-closed: ordinary atlas and oversized picture-in-picture caches are RGBA8 targets cleared to transparent zero, their final vanilla blits use ONE / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA premultiplied blending, and the vanilla textured shader does not premultiply its input.

Use client-only string-targeted pseudo mixins at the exact audited Item Interactions 26.2.2 tooltip factory, component, and physical-slot rendering seams; activate only when Easy Shulker Boxes and Item Interactions are both present and the supported shulker has reservations.
Validate against exact Easy Shulker Boxes 26.2.3 and its nested Item Interactions 26.2.2 artifact bytes while keeping both runtime metadata predicates flexible and optional.

Preserve the exact user-bound Canary 2 RUNTIME_FAIL: its literal zero and other revised reservation presentation were acceptable, but empty-reservation sprites appeared excessively dark; no other checklist row is inferred.
Retain the reported Stacks Are Stacks incompatibility only as a deferred observation; it was not investigated, fixed, deployed, or tested by Canary 3.

exclusions: Copper chests, arbitrary modded containers, player inventory, equipment, crafting and result slots, trinket slots, trash slots, fake slots, and foreign menu slots.
Automatic sorting, item routing, destination selection, routing priority, dump-all behavior, restock quantities, cross-container templates, category or tag matching, and multiple identities per slot.
Changes to vanilla extraction, ordinary chest or barrel drop metadata, unsupported container ownership, or vanilla QUICK_MOVE and hopper ordering beyond reservation admission.

Fake zero-count stacks, mutation of DataComponents.CONTAINER, precomposition against #43362A or black, a baked matte or backing fill, reservation-aware Easy Shulker Boxes insertion or extraction controls, or changes to tooltip fullness, dimensions, selection, scrolling, collapsing, highlighting, colors, names, storage bars, or mouse interactions.

Hard runtime dependencies or restrictive upper bounds for Easy Shulker Boxes or Item Interactions, direct modification or redistribution of either upstream artifact, or optional-class linkage outside safely gated client mixins.
Any Stacks Are Stacks workaround, modification of projects/stacks-are-stacks-container-fixes, deployment of its Canary 1, or change to stack-capacity semantics for the deferred report.
Minecraft client launch, inferred runtime evidence, successor acceptance or promotion, or mutation of the exact accepted Canary 1, failed Canary 2, or their provenance.
